item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will bring rather cool and dry weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be mainly fine over the region and temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise gradually over the region during the New Year holidays.

Date/Month: 29/12 (Thursday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and dry. Rather cool in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 14 - 18 C
R.H. range: 50 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
